movelist.name: Endeavor
movelist.effect: The target loses a Tick of Hit Points for each Injury the user has.

movelist.name: Crunch
movelist.effect: Crunch lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+

movelist.name: Dragon Breath
movelist.effect: Dragon Breath Paralyzes the Target on 15+.

movelist.name: Acrobatics
movelist.effect: If the user is not holding an item, Acrobatics instead has a Damage Base of 11 (3d10+10 / 27).

movelist.name: Quick Guard
movelist.effect: If the user or an adjacent ally is targeted by a Priority or Interrupt Attack, Quick Guard may be declared as an Interrupt, causing the triggering attack to have no effect.

movelist.name: Agility
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Defeatist
abilities.effect: The user gain a +2d6 Bonus to Damage Rolls while over 50% of its Maximum Hit Points. While at 50% Max Hit Points or lower, the user gains a -5 penalty to Damage Rolls and +10 Initiative.

abilities.name: Frighten
abilities.effect: Lower the target’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Conqueror
abilities.trigger: The user causes a foe to Faint by using a
abilities.effect: The user’s Attack, Special Attack, and Speed gain +1 Combat Stage.
